claim: Unlike KNOW38's stale bank-only forecasts, immediate global soft Bayesian filtering of observed consequences may give fast predictive adaptation while deferred capped A/B long-term writes preserve old regime memory. Must beat FIT-selected strong temporal HMM, not only weak ablations.
novelty: Global soft regime belief affects readout after each witnessed action-consequence; eight-event global buffer isolates provisional observations before permanent updates; persistent banks are separately capped and cold-restorable. No tokenization or transformer.

algorithm.state: Two Beta(1,1) banks of 8 physical inputs, cap six writes per input/bank; global p_A posterior initialized .95; one shared eight-event pending (x,y) queue; 0-256 received events, switches count as number of sealed batches committed to B
algorithm.initial_bootstrap: When bank zero is not fully populated to six per physical x, every sealed batch commits to bank zero, up to per-cell cap. This initial training uses only witnessed counts, no true phase labels.
algorithm.prior: For every pre-update prob or post-observation Bayesian update, predicted weight p_A_prior = p_A*(1-h)+(1-p_A)*h, where h is the same FIT-selected hazard as HMM.
algorithm.readout: candidate forecast = p_A_prior*P_A(y=1|x)+(1-p_A_prior)*P_B(y=1|x). No long-term write is necessary for each forecast.
algorithm.posterior: Upon observed y, using pre-commit Beta bank readouts, p_A <- [prior*L_A(y|x)]/[prior*L_A+(1-prior)*L_B]. Only the true witnessed y updates the fast posterior. The candidate does not access private law, seed, phase or future y.
algorithm.commit: At exactly each eighth global observed consequence, after fast posterior update, if bootstrap needed commit pending 8 to A; else if current p_A>=.9 commit to A; else if p_A<=.1 commit to B; else discard pending as ambiguous. Commit all 8 to selected persistent bank capped at six writes per cell. Always clear pending. A-only or ambiguous observations never write the unselected bank.
algorithm.fallback: A or B bank that is fully capped remains immutable. Prior and posterior remain fast and ephemeral; checkpoint includes p_A, hazard, pending, both bank states, caps, and received count.
algorithm.cold: Canonical JSON SHA256 readback at 64/128/192/256 and prefix forks, <=4096 checkpoint bytes; reject duplicate keys, bad types/nonfinite values, forged witness counts.

controls.HMM: Exact prior KNOW36 fully online two-bank global HMM Comparator('hmm'), FIT-selected h in [1/128,1/32,1/8] by mean FIT t>=64 expected Brier, not refitted to HELD.
controls.hard_readout: Same candidate's hazard, posterior, delayed writes, budgets, but forecast from whichever bank has global posterior weight>=0.5; isolates soft forecast benefit.
controls.no_buffer: Same posterior and capped persistent A/B banks, but decides each observed y immediately via p_A>=.9 or <=.1, otherwise no write; isolates effect of delayed write admission.
controls.no_switch: Same candidate but p_A permanently fixed at .95, slow A-only capped memory, cannot infer B; weak negative.
controls.know38: Unmodified KNOW38 candidate staged-local hard switch, frozen before this work.
controls.rolling: Unmodified conventional rolling-last8 input memory. Same actions/events, byte/CPU not exactly matched.
controls.cost_note: Report each method exact checkpoint bytes and Python per-observe cost; strong HMM has 16 Beta heads, candidate same number plus pending. No efficiency claim without matched CPU and reference.

source.public_tape: x=(t%8) XOR (((t//8)%2)<<1), 16 public context/actions per 16 events, no phase tags
source.laws: unchanged original KNOW36 q_for A/B1/B2, P(y=1)=.85 or .15
source.phases: A64→B64→A64→B64, plus A-only sham branch sharing A64 prefix
source.first_use: prospective source-only one-shot exactly after full focused Linux/Windows, atlas, complete dual-OS final regression, real-source read-only compatibility, and pre-source exact blobs. No tests call private_y/proof; no unknown or consumed trial replay.

score.primary: second B t192..255 expected prequential Brier on each held family, true q only evaluator, before model observe; paired wins vs HMM
score.secondary: B first t64..127, returning A t128..191, A-prefix, cold stability, sham false B commits, posterior bank hashes, total novel source calls, checkpoint/CPU.

hypotheses.P0: source 12 FIT and 24 disjoint HELD, exact 3072 FIT +9216 HELD uniquely opened, 10752 model occurrences/arm, 16 public action/context support, no private fields given to learner, exact cold restore
hypotheses.P1: candidate A-prefix expected Brier <=0.23 both B1 and B2
hypotheses.H1: candidate second-B mean expected Brier <= FIT-selected HMM minus .005 in BOTH families and >=9/12 paired wins in each
hypotheses.H2: candidate second-B mean expected Brier <= hard_readout minus .005 AND no_buffer minus .005 AND know38 minus .005 in BOTH families
hypotheses.H3: candidate returning A mean Brier <= FIT-selected HMM +.005 both families
hypotheses.H4: A original bank at t64 is exactly byte-identical at t128/t192 in all 24; B bank at t128 byte-identical at t192 in all 24; cold restored state and readout identical at every phase boundary
hypotheses.H5: A-only control suffers <=2/24 false B admissions after t64, every candidate checkpoint<4096 bytes

score.decision: DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORTED iff P0,P1,H1,H2,H3,H4,H5 all true; any failure -> DEVELOPMENT_MIXED_OR_NO_GO. Native SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false regardless of synthetic output. No merge/deployment.
score.stops: NO post-result tuning, no reusing KNOW34/36/37/38 FIT/HELD, no retries after uncertain/consumed first use; preserve negatives and immutable provenance. One source-only first attempt after exact final regression.
